BiblicalUsage: A pledge or pawn is something given as security until a promise is kept. Judah promises Tamar a kid from the flock and gives her his signet, his bracelets, and his staff as a pledge, and when he sends the kid to redeem the pledge, she cannot be found.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a pledge is only as good as the man who gives it. Judah gave what identified him, his signet and staff, and the story will not let him forget it.
